definitions.explanation: The muscular organ in the mouth used for tasting, speaking, and eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{舌|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{火傷|やけど}した→火傷：04077_yakedo⟧。
examples.english: I burned my tongue on something hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舌|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The dog is running with its tongue out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたら→食べる：00396_taberu⟧、{舌|した}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ヒリヒリ→ひりひり：05263_hirihiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My tongue stings after eating something spicy.
examples.notes: ヒリヒリ = stinging, burning sensation

notes:
{舌|した} refers to the tongue, the organ used for tasting and speaking.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {舌|した}を{出|だ}す: to stick out one's tongue
- {舌|した}を{巻|ま}く: to be amazed/impressed
- {舌|した}が{回|まわ}る: to speak fluently
- {舌|した}を{噛|か}む: to bite one's tongue (also: to trip over words)

COMPOUNDS:
- {舌先|したさき}: tip of the tongue
- {毒舌|どくぜつ}: sharp tongue, caustic remarks
- {二枚舌|にまいじた}: double-tongued, deceitful
- {舌打|したう}ち: clicking one's tongue (in disapproval)

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {口|くち}: mouth
- {唇|くちびる}: lips
- {歯|は}: teeth
